method: Full pinned license text reads and Git/SHA256 verification. CC0 files proven byte-identical and shared full text reviewed once with both tracked identities verified. Text inventory, not a legal compatibility opinion.
findings: BLAKE2 COPYING and BLAKE3 LICENSE_CC0 contain byte-identical CC0 1.0 Universal text: waiver, fallback license and limitations/disclaimers. Separate paths are tracked blobs, not duplicate reading-count for a single path.

BLAKE3 LICENSE_A2 contains Apache2.0 text including definitions, copyright/patent grants, redistribution/NOTICE conditions, contribution terms, trademark/warranty/liability sections and2019 author notice.
LICENSE_A2LLVM includes Apache2.0 plus LLVM exceptions concerning embedded object-form portions and specified GPLv2 combined-software conditions; this extra text is not identical to plain Apache2.0.
Presence of these nested texts does not by itself select a license for every source or override GPL notices in rmlint-owned files. No blanket relicensing or compatibility conclusion inferred.
No vendor source was copied into production by this review. Existing repository-level reference-only decision remains while file-specific provenance and license selection require separate evidence.
limits: License-text inventory only; no runtime or performance evidence, root COPYING remains unread.
